title: The Littlewood-Paley formula and mean counting function for vertical limits of Dirichlet series
summary: We prove a Littlewood-Paley formula for the Hardy space of Dirichlet series $\mathscr{H}^p$ with $1\leq p<\infty$ in terms of almost every vertical limit function. This significantly strengthens previous results, which hold either only as an average over the vertical limit functions or under additional assumptions of uniform convergence. As part of our approach, we obtain a Hardy-Stein identity for the derivative of the $p$-mean of almost every vertical limit.
